idea.title: The k. problem
idea.summary: A one-letter text 'k.' has no tone, so you overthink it; a stranger on a call laughs and settles the mystery in seconds.
hookOptions: She texted me 'k.' Am I in trouble?
I overthought one letter for an hour
Texting hides the one thing you need

scenes.say: She texted me 'k.' Am I in trouble?

scenes.name: Tipsy Teapot
scenes.say: One hour of overthinking. Zero answers.

scenes.name: Jolly Anchor
scenes.say: So I called a stranger and asked for a second opinion.

scenes.name: Jolly Anchor
scenes.say: He laughed: 'Bro, I'm fine, I just type short.' Mystery solved.

post.caption: A text can say 'ok' in ten different moods. A voice can't hide it. Which text have you overthought the most? Try a voice call with someone new at randomtalker.com
